interface.signature: def createTree(parent: list[int], N: int) -> Optional[TreeNode]

preconditions.description: parent is a list of integers with length exactly N.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in parent)
preconditions.description: Every element in parent is an integer.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < N or x == -1 for x in parent)
preconditions.description: Each parent value is either -1 (root) or a valid node index between 0 and N-1.

preconditions.expression: sum(1 for x in parent if x == -1) == 1
preconditions.description: Exactly one node has -1 as its parent, representing the unique root.
N is within the specified constraint range.

postconditions.description: The function returns a non-null root node.
The returned root node's data value matches the index of the -1 entry in the parent array.

postconditions.expression: all(hasattr(n, 'data') and hasattr(n, 'left') and hasattr(n, 'right') for n in _collect_nodes(return_value))
postconditions.description: Every node in the constructed tree has 'data', 'left', and 'right' attributes.
The set of data values in the tree exactly matches the set of all node indices from 0 to N-1.
For every node, its parent relationship in the tree structure matches the parent array, respecting the left-child-first rule for siblings.
